Outbank – The all-in-one finance app for individuals, freelancers, and small businesses.
Manage all your bank accounts, contracts, insurance policies, and budgets in one app — ad-free, encrypted, and completely private.

Whether you're managing personal or business accounts, Outbank helps you stay in control of your finances.

YOUR MONEY. YOUR DATA.
Your financial data belongs to you — and no one else. Outbank stores your data directly on your device. The app communicates directly with your financial providers — no external servers, no tracking, no profiling, and no saving of data.

Outbank is for you if:
- You have multiple bank accounts (personal and/or business)
- You want 100% privacy and data security
- You want to budget smarter and save money

ALL YOUR FINANCES IN ONE APP – MULTIBANKING FOR DACH
Simply connect all your accounts to the app. Outbank supports over 4,500 banks and financial providers across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland – more than any other multibanking app.
* Bank Accounts: Checking Account, Savings Account, Overnight Money Account, Securities Depot
* Credit Cards: Debit Card, Visa, Mastercard, American Express, ADAC, IKEA & Amazon Credit Card
* SCHUFA-Score
* Insurances: Allianz, HUK, myLife, HDI, IDEAL
* Investments & Trading: Trade Republic, Scalable Capital, flatexDEGIRO, DWS Investments, Mintos, eToro, Bitpanda
* Digital Payment Services: PayPal, Klarna, Shoop, Amazon, Wise
* Crypto & Digital Wallets: Binance, Bitcoin.de, Ethereum, Kraken, Coinbase – incl. real-time currency conversion 
* Loyalty Programs: Miles & More, BahnBonus & Payback
* Shopping Accounts: REWE, Lidl Plus, EDEKA, dm
* Offline Accounts: Cashflow Tracking, Household Books, Precious Metals, Collectibles, Real Estate, and Company Shares
* Top Banks: Sparkasse, Volksbank, Raiffeisenbanken, ING, Commerzbank, Comdirect, DKB, Deutsche Bank, Postbank, Haspa, Sparda Bank, Consorsbank, Apobank, HVB, GLS Bank, Hanseatic Bank, SWK Bank, TF Bank, C24, Finom, Qonto, Fidor Bank, KfW, Santander, Targobank, BMW Bank, Volkswagen Bank, Bank of Scotland, Bank Norwegian, Ikano Bank, DAB, Signal Iduna, Airplus – and many more.

quotes.text:
Not mentioned yet in this subthread, but worth checking out because it runs fully local: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.stoegerit.outbank.android

It's not perfect, for example its monthly/yearly subscription detection didn't work great for me, but compared to all those apps that involve trusting a third party with your banking data it's worth a look.
